title: CRAP
wikitext: '''Compact Raid and Party''' (CRAP) is a World of Warcraft (1.12) add-on that replaces the default party and raid frames with a more compact group frame. == How to install == Either clone the repository to your WoW/Interface/Add-ons folder, or download manually via github (click on Clone or Download -> Download ZIP. Do not forget to rename the directory to "CRAP" afterwards. == Git links == '''[https://github.com/vargv666/CRAP (vargv666)]''' == Preview == [[File:Crap1.png|frameless|347x347px]] == Features == * Can be re-positioned and resized * Heal prediction * Range check * [https://github.com/Lexiebean/Clique Clique] click-casting support == Commands == Basic customization via the /crap in-game command [[Category:Addon]]
